answer: A payout is split and thus 42% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The gale schedule is applied in prism and wharf shows each instalment. Someone hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3771 identities would post 1362 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
